info.title: GitLab
info.description: A connector for GitLab DevOps platform. Manage projects, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines, issues, and automate DevOps workflows.

get.description: Retrieve version information for this GitLab instance.

post.description: Create a new project owned by the authenticated user.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the new project.

parameters.name: namespace_id
parameters.description: Namespace ID for the new project.

parameters.name: initialize_with_readme
parameters.description: Initialize the repository with a readme.

get.description: Retrieves details of a single GitLab project by its numeric ID.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

post.description: Fork a project into the user namespace of the authenticated user.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path assigned to the resultant project after forking.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name assigned to the resultant project after forking.

get.description: Compare a branch, tag, or commit in a project.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The commit SHA or branch name to compare from.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The commit SHA or branch name to compare to.

parameters.name: from_project_id
parameters.description: The ID of the project to compare from.

post.description: Create a new branch in the repository.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: The name of the branch.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch name or commit SHA to create branch from.

post.description: Create a commit by posting a JSON payload.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Name of the branch to commit into.

parameters.name: commit_message
parameters.description: Commit message.

parameters.name: actions
parameters.description: Commit actions payload.

action.description: Action to perform: create, delete, move, update, or chmod.

content.description: File content (required for create and update actions).

get.description: Get a file from a repository.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: URL-encoded full path to the file.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: The name of branch, tag, or commit.

post.description: Create a pipeline trigger for a project.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The trigger name.

post.description: Trigger a CI/CD pipeline using a trigger token.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The pipeline trigger token.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: The name of branch, tag, or commit.

post.description: Enable a runner in a project.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: runner_id
parameters.description: The ID of a runner.

get.description: Lists merge requests for a project with optional filters for state, date range, labels, and milestone.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter by MR state. Default: all.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Return MRs created after this ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: updated_after
parameters.description: Return MRs updated after this ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Comma-separated label names to filter by.

parameters.name: milestone
parameters.description: Milestone title to filter by.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Scope of results. Default: created_by_me.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Order results by: created_at, updated_at. Default: created_at.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort direction: asc or desc. Default: desc.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1-100). Default is 20.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: source_branch
parameters.description: The source branch.

parameters.name: target_branch
parameters.description: The target branch.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Title of the merge request.

get.description: Retrieves full details of a single merge request by project ID and merge request IID.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: merge_request_iid
parameters.description: The project-scoped merge request ID (the number shown in the GitLab UI).

put.description: Update a merge request (title, description, state, etc.).

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: merge_request_iid
parameters.description: The project-scoped merge request ID (the number shown in the GitLab UI).

parameters.name: state_event
parameters.description: Update the status: close or reopen.

put.description: Accept and merge changes submitted with a merge request.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: merge_request_iid
parameters.description: The project-scoped merge request ID (the number shown in the GitLab UI).

parameters.name: merge_commit_message
parameters.description: Custom merge commit message.

parameters.name: squash
parameters.description: Squash commits into a single commit on merge.

parameters.name: should_remove_source_branch
parameters.description: Remove the source branch after merge.

post.description: Adds a comment (note) to an existing merge request.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: merge_request_iid
parameters.description: The project-scoped merge request ID (the number shown in the GitLab UI).

get.description: Lists CI/CD pipelines for a project with optional filters for status, branch, and date range.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by pipeline status.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Filter by branch or tag name.

parameters.name: updated_after
parameters.description: Return pipelines updated after this ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: updated_before
parameters.description: Return pipelines updated before this ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Order results by: id, status, ref, updated_at, user_id. Default: id.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort direction: asc or desc. Default: desc.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1-100). Default is 20.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

get.description: Retrieves full details of a single CI/CD pipeline including duration, user, and status information.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: pipeline_id
parameters.description: The pipeline ID.

get.description: Lists all jobs for a specific CI/CD pipeline, optionally filtered by job status.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: pipeline_id
parameters.description: The pipeline ID.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Filter by job status. Comma-separated values: created, pending, running, failed, success, canceled, skipped, manual.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1-100). Default is 20.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

post.description: Retries all failed and canceled jobs in a CI/CD pipeline.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: pipeline_id
parameters.description: The pipeline ID.

get.description: Retrieves the raw text log (trace) output of a CI/CD job.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: The job ID.

get.description: Lists issues for a project with optional filters for state, labels, milestone, assignee, and date range.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter by issue state. Default: all.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Comma-separated label names. Use None for unlabeled, Any for any label.

parameters.name: milestone
parameters.description: Milestone title to filter by.

parameters.name: assignee_id
parameters.description: Filter by assignee user ID. Use 0 for unassigned.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Return issues created after this ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: updated_after
parameters.description: Return issues updated after this ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Order results by: created_at, updated_at, priority, due_date, label_priority. Default: created_at.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort direction: asc or desc. Default: desc.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1-100). Default is 20.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

post.description: Creates a new issue in a GitLab project.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

get.description: Retrieves full details of a single issue by project ID and issue IID.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: issue_iid
parameters.description: The project-scoped issue ID (the number shown in the GitLab UI).

post.description: Adds a comment (note) to an existing issue.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the GitLab project.

parameters.name: issue_iid
parameters.description: The project-scoped issue ID.
